about.label: About
about.heading: Marketing, operations and AI in the same brain.
about.paragraph1: I didn't trade marketing for code, I went deeper. I come from operations: tight deadlines, big brands and a team of 100 people waiting on an answer.
about.paragraph2: I build AI by that same standard. If it can't survive the daily routine of the people using it, it doesn't leave my hands.

items.title: An agent that never sleeps
items.desc: Answers, triages and books on your customer's WhatsApp at any hour. When a case needs a human, it hands it to you.
items.detail: An agent wired to the WhatsApp Cloud API, with conversation memory, intent classification and escalation rules. When the subject falls outside what it handles, the conversation goes to a person with the history attached.

items.title: The system your company can't buy off the shelf
items.desc: When no ready-made tool fits, I build yours, from the first prototype to the system running with your customers inside it.
flow: Your process exactly as it is
items.detail: Products like a medical front desk and a legal assistant, from MVP to production: multi-tenant database, authentication, admin panel and continuous deployment.

items.title: Answers pulled from your own documents
items.desc: The AI stops making things up and starts answering from your contracts, manuals and spreadsheets.
flow: An answer with its source attached
items.detail: I index your documents as embeddings and serve the right passage to the model at question time. pgvector on Supabase, section-level chunking and the source cited alongside the answer, so you can check where it came from.

items.title: Repetitive work leaves your hands
items.desc: That task of carrying data from one system to another starts happening on its own, wiring together the tools you already use.
flow: The flow fires on its own
It arrives ready in the other
items.detail: Multi-step flows in n8n, with error handling and reprocessing, connecting CRM, spreadsheets, email and WhatsApp. What is copy and paste today becomes a trigger.

items.title: Image and video at campaign speed
items.desc: Marketing and activation assets produced with AI, at scale, without stalling the schedule waiting on a production slot.
items.detail: Art direction, generation and finishing of image, video and audio with AI, including custom ComfyUI pipelines to hold brand consistency across the assets.

items.title: Sites and interfaces that convert
items.desc: Landing pages and digital products designed to be clear for the people using them and to sell to the people paying.
flow: Who uses it and what they need
Design and code in the same hands
items.detail: UX, UI and code in the same hands: design system, accessibility, performance and measurement. This site is an example of the standard.

items.title: A lawyer who never misses a deadline again
items.desc: Watches the cases on the court systems, works out the deadlines on its own and shows how each judge tends to rule.
items.detail: Seven independent engines monitoring the PJe and DJe court systems, procedural deadline calculation and profiling of how judges decide, intelligence that wasn't available off the shelf. ~10k lines, multi-tenant, compliant with Brazil's data protection law.

items.title: The clinic's front desk, 24 hours a day
items.desc: Triages, books appointments and answers questions on the patient's WhatsApp. The doctor gets the day's summary ready.
items.detail: Six autonomous agents across two channels: triage, scheduling and FAQ on the patient channel; summaries and alerts on the doctor channel. Runs 24/7 without intervention.

items.title: 29 AI specialists arguing over your problem
items.desc: Each one defends a point of view, they debate each other and the decision comes out of a weighted vote.
items.detail: A platform with 29 AI personas, interaction rules between them and voting weighted by each agent's competence on the topic under debate.

items.title: Content that feeds itself
items.desc: Sweeps 33 sources all day, picks what matters and delivers the text ready for review.
items.detail: An autonomous pipeline monitoring 33 RSS sources, with a relevance filter and LLM-optimized content generation, 24 hours a day.

items.title: Who does what, on a single screen
items.desc: Company site plus a living org chart to see the agency's teams and projects without a spreadsheet.
items.detail: Institutional site plus an org chart for visual management of teams and projects. An internal product of the agency, in production.

items.title: This site

items.detail: A portfolio built as a vertical immersive deck: scenes that stack with depth, i18n in three languages and an AI agent that presents the site and then turns into a chat.

invite.text: Hey! I'm Leko. Well, almost: I'm his AI agent (his face included). Want me to show you around the site my way?

steps.inicio: This is my calling card: AI strategy for marketing, creativity, and productivity. Come along and I'll show you what that means in practice.
steps.sobre: Before the code, there was a stage: 15 years in marketing and events, 1,000+ productions for brands like Jack Daniel's, Red Bull, and Ambev. That's where my way of solving problems comes from.
steps.tese: My thesis fits in three words: strategy that ships. What I design, I put in production. Pretty slides don't pay the bills.
steps.construo: This is what I build: support that never sleeps, custom systems for what you can't buy ready-made, answers pulled from your own documents, repetitive work leaving your hands, and the creative layer on top, image and video at campaign speed.
steps.diferenciais: Why me and not an agency? Because here, the person who understands the business, designs the solution, and writes the code is the same person.
steps.portfolio: Real products, running right now: Donna in legal, Smart Health in medicine, Konklave with 29 AI agents debating each other. No proofs of concept.
steps.experiencia: The full journey is here: from operating major events to applied AI engineering.
steps.formacao: Academic grounding too: an MBA in AI for Business and continuous study, because this field waits for no one.
steps.stack: My everyday tools: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, n8n, Supabase, Next.js, and the AI creative arsenal. By the way, I'm built with one of them myself.
steps.contato: And that's it! If anything here made sense for your business, this is the way. Or better: want to talk to me right now? Ask me anything.
steps.resultados: And marketing isn't just my past: it's results with numbers on them. From zero to 50 thousand organic followers, over a thousand events produced and an operation of more than a hundred people.
